AgentKind.description: What kind of agent a member is.

oneOf.description: A team member in its own right.
Pinned to one person; acts within that person's access (C9).

message_id.description: The call-record message in the DM.

my_ring.description: The viewer's own ring (READY, the member's copy only).

participant_ids.description: Members with a voice entry in the call now (connecting or connected), ascending.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

CallEndReason.description: Why a call ended (§14.5). Stored in `calls.end_reason`.

oneOf.description: The media engine lost the call.
The media engine failed before anyone connected.

CallKeysParams.description:
The client timings and constants the server relays (READY `call_keys.params` and every
[`CallKeysInit`]; S50 §9.4, S51 §20.1). The single source for client timings.

ciphersuites.description: The ciphersuites the server accepts (`[1]` in v1).

client_activate_fallback_ms.description: A sender that acked but hears no `activate` switches after this long.

exporter_label.description: The MLS exporter label of frame keys ([`tls::EXPORTER_LABEL`]).

key_package_max_lifetime_s.description: Longest KeyPackage lifetime the server accepts.

retire_after_ms.description: Receivers retire an old slot this long after `activate`.

unknown_call_buffer_ms.description: Dispatches for a `call_id` the client does not know yet are buffered this long.

CallPublicKey.description: A public key and its id (`kid` = hex of the first 8 bytes of SHA-256 of the raw key).

CallRing.description: One ring of a call (§14.1). Only rung members appear; the starter never does.

expires_at.description: When an unanswered ring becomes `missed` (only while `ringing` or `busy`).

Capture.description: Whether a granted participant's microphone is actually captured (§9.2).

ChannelNotifyPrefs.description: A member's prefs for one channel or DM.

effective_level.description: The level in effect for this member here.

muted_until.description: When the mute ends; absent = until unmuted (or not muted).

oneOf.description: An announcement channel: `@everyone` posts only in threads by default.
A 1:1 DM (no space, slug or name; always private).
A group DM of up to 9 people.

Consent.description:
What a participant said to the recording notice (§9.2). Stored in
`recording_participants.consent`.

oneOf.description: In the room, has not answered.
Refused; stays in the room unrecorded (unless declining means not joining).

ConsentPrompt.description:
The consent modal's data (rev 91, §9.10). Every slot is data; templates supply the
sentences. `notice_version` is a stable hash of every other slot; the answer must echo it.

admin_download.description: Authorised compliance admins can download the audio (always `true` in v1).

audio_keep_days.description: How long audio is kept (0 = until the transcript is final).

notice_version.description: A stable hash of every other slot value.

recorded_now.description: Who is currently recorded (granted and captured), ascending.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

started_by.description: Who started it (`None` for an auto channel with no recording yet).

DigestAvailability.description: Whether the member gets an email digest, and why not.

available.description: A digest can be sent to this member now.

DigestInterval.description: How often the email digest may be sent (`notify_settings.digest_interval` codes 0–3).

DndDay.description: A weekday of a DND rule.

DndRule.description:
One weekly DND rule: from `start` on each listed day to `end` (the next day when `end <
start`).

timezone.description: IANA override; absent = the member's profile timezone, else UTC.

DndState.description: Whether a member is on DND now, and until when (S21 holds notifications until `until`).

until.description: When it ends; absent = indefinite (or off).

InstallRole.description: Install-wide role (C12). Separate from space roles.

oneOf.description: Spaces, policies, members, guests. No content access to private channels or DMs.

A meeting link guest (Meet MC2a, C6 amendment CC1, CC3): made by redeeming a meeting
link, bound to one meeting channel, capped by `LINK_GUEST_MASK`, never a K2
principal. Every S19 guest rule applies, and only the link-guest allowlist passes.

MediaPolicy.description:
The client media policy (S34 v2 §13): in join answers, `voice_server_updated`, READY
`install.media` and `media_policy_updated`.

codecs.description: Video codecs in preference order (never AV1 or H.265; empty with video off).

tier.description: The budget tier the hints are for.

vp9.description: VP9 rules, when VP9 is configured.

oneOf.description: New camera leases refused; lower hints.
New camera and screen leases refused; lowest hints.

Member.description: A member of the install, person or agent.

assistant_of.description: For assistants, the member id of their person.

compliance.description: Whether the member holds the compliance flag; sent only to the member themself.

custom_fields.description:
Custom field values the viewer may see; only on `GET /members/{id}` and the self object
(S18).

email.description: Email address; sent only to the member themself.

managed_fields.description: Fields the client must show read-only; self only (S18).

profile_rev.description: Bumped by every change of this object; clients drop older events (S18).

status.description: Status; absent when none or expired (S18).

MemberKind.description: Whether a member is a person or an agent.

MemberStatus.description: A member's status: text and/or one emoji, with an optional expiry.

MyRing.description: The member's own ring in READY (`Call.my_ring`, the member's copy only).

silent.description: A silent ring (busy, DND or a muted DM).

NotRecordedReason.description:
Why a granted participant is not captured (§9.2). Stored in
`recording_participants.capture_reason`.

oneOf.description: A track cap is reached; not allowlisted.
The recorder could not decrypt the member's frames.
Not subscribable under the room's permissions.
Mentions, DMs, keywords and followed threads.

default_level.description: The account default; `null` = the install default.

effective_default_level.description: What space channels fall back to for this member.

keywords.description:
The keywords (only in `GET /me/notify` and `POST /me/notify/set`; never in READY or
events).

mute_lets_mentions.description: Direct mentions still notify in muted channels.

PolicyDigest.description:
The policy values clients need at boot, carried in READY (gap G10). Field names are the
policy keys with `.` replaced by `_`.

calls_dm_enabled.description:
`calls.dm_enabled` (S34 v2): clients hide the DM call button when off. Old payloads
read as `true`.

calls_verification_code.description:
`calls.verification_code` (S50 §16.4): a change reaches clients in `install_updated`.
Old payloads read as `shown`.

guests_enabled.description: `guests.enabled` (S19). Old payloads without it read as `true`.

guests_invite.description: `guests.invite` (S19): members' clients show "Add guest" only when they may.

recording_enabled.description: `recording.enabled` (S35 v2): clients hide Record when off. Old payloads read `false`.

PresenceSettings.description: A member's presence settings and what they see about themselves.

dnd_skip_until.description: The current schedule window is skipped until then.

effective_timezone.description: The timezone schedules use (`UTC` when none is set).

self_status.description: What the member sees about themself.

ProfileFieldValue.description: One custom field value on a `Member`.

PromptMember.description: The starter as the consent modal shows them.

PromptRoomKind.description: The room kind the modal names.

posted_to_channel.description: Transcripts are posted into the channel as ordinary messages.

ReadState.description: A member's read state in one channel (C8; prd-sew-14 §5).

last_message_id.description:
The channel's newest timeline message (omitted in READY, where the channel entry has
it).

last_read_id.description:
The read cursor: a comparator, possibly a synthetic id (mark unread writes
`message_id − 1`). Absent = nothing read.

mention_count.description: Unread mentions (a muted channel counts direct mentions only).

muted.description: The member muted the channel (S21); present only when true.

seq.description: The member change-log head this state is current as of (S14 gap G9).

unread.description: Whether a message by someone else is past the cursor.

ReadyCallKeys.description:
READY `call_keys` (S50 §9.4): the trust anchors and client parameters. Absent when voice is
disabled.

crl.description: Serials of revoked, unexpired device certificates (at most 5,000).

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

crl_partial.description: More revoked serials exist: page them with `GET /api/v1/devices/crl`.

ds_public_key.description: The raw 32-byte DS Ed25519 key, for pinning.

ReadyChannel.description: A channel in READY: every channel the member belongs to, plus DMs.

assistant_reader_ids.description:
Assistants that read this DM through their pinned person (contracts rev 11 G21);
absent for space channels.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

dm_member_ids.description: The DM's members; empty for space channels.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

file_retention_days.description: Effective file retention in days (S22 §14.3); absent = forever.

has_guests.description: At least one guest is a member (S19 §15). Old payloads read as `false`.

head_seq.description: Head of the channel change log.

recording_audio_days.description:
The channel's default audio keep days for recordings (S35 v2 §12.1); absent = the org
default.

recording_auto.description: Voice channels: a recording starts on the first join (S35 v2 §8.3). Absent = off.

recording_require_consent.description:
Voice channels: declining the recording notice means not joining (S35 v2 §9.11);
absent = the org policy `recording.require_consent_to_join`.

retention_days.description: Effective message retention in days (S22 §14.3); absent = forever.

slow_mode_s.description: Slow mode in seconds; present only when on (S12 §7).

media.description: The client media policy for the current tier (S34 v2 §13); absent when voice is off.

profile_fields_version.description: The custom field definitions etag (`fields_rev`, S18).

sync_epoch.description:
The install's sync epoch: an opaque decimal string that changes only on a restore. A
value different from the client's stored one means "drop every cache and cursor"
(contracts rev 29). Empty from servers that predate it.

video_enabled.description: `[voice.video] enabled` and voice enabled (S34 v2 §20.2). Absent means `false`.

ReadyNotify.description:
READY's notification section: the settings (without keywords) and the explicit rows for
READY's channels and spaces.

channel_prefs.description: Channels and DMs with a level or a mute.

hidden.description:
Meet MC1 (CC4): a hidden Space; present only for clients that declared `hidden_spaces`
(others never get the Space). Absent when `false`.

my_role_ids.description: The member's roles in this space.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

my_space_perms.description:
The member's base permissions in the space (`space_perms`, S12 §7). Old payloads read
as 0.

ReadyVersions.description: Etags for lazy per-space fetches with `If-None-Match` (gap G9).

ReadyVoiceChannel.description: A public voice channel in READY that the member can VIEW but has not joined (S33 v1 §16.3).

audio_keep_days.description: Audio keep days (0 = until the transcript is final).

auto.description: Started by an auto-record channel's first join.

call_record_id.description: The DM call (`calls.id`) of a DM-call recording.

consent_prompt.description: The consent modal (self only, while the viewer is `pending`).

mixed.description: A mixed file is made after stop.

my_consent.description: The viewer's own consent (self only; absent for non-participants).

participants.description: Members in the room plus members who ever granted, ascending.

RecordingParticipant.description: One participant of a recording, as everyone in the audience sees it (§18.1).

RecordingState.description: A recording's lifecycle state (§8.5). Stored in `recordings.state`.

RingState.description: A ring's state as every DM member sees it (§14.1, §15).

oneOf.description: Ringing, but the callee is already in voice (a silent ring).
Not answered in time, or the call ended first.

SelfStatus.description: What a member sees about their own presence.

SpaceNotifyPrefs.description: A member's level for one space.

effective_level.description: What the space's channels fall back to for this member.

StopReason.description: Why a recording stopped (§8.5). Stored in `recordings.stop_reason`.

oneOf.description: No standard voice entries left in the room.
The recorder failed (join timeout, certificate, unreachable, too many rejoins).
The engine room was lost beyond the re-admit grace.
Recording was disabled (policy, config, archive, `sew recording disable`).

ThreadsInbox.description: The threads inbox summary (READY, `GET /api/v1/me/threads/summary`, S14 events).

mention_count.description: Unread thread mentions over every thread in the sync set, followed or not (S14).

seq.description: The member change-log head these totals are current as of (S14).

TrackHint.description: Publishing hints for one source (S34 v2 §13).

VerificationCode.description:
Policy `calls.verification_code` (S50 §16.4): whether "Call info → Security code" is
shown. `required` is reserved for a later mode and refused by the policy validator.

oneOf.description: Shown on request, never modal (the default).
Reserved: "confirm before you speak" (refused in v1).

VideoCodec.description:
A video codec a client may publish under E2EE (S34 v2 D8). There is no AV1 or H.265
value: they are never offered.

oneOf.description: VP9, only with the Dependency Descriptor (opt-in).
Every space member can see and join it.

VoiceConnection.description: Whether the engine has confirmed the member's media (S33 v2 §10.1).

oneOf.description: The admit is registered; media not confirmed yet.
The engine confirmed the participant (also during a reconnect window).

call_id.description: The DM call (`calls.id`) of a call entry (S34 v2 §20.1); absent in voice channels.

joined_at.description: When the join succeeded (a move resets it).

secure.description: The member's device is in the activated key epoch (S50 `secure_changed`).

self_stream.description: The member holds a screen-share lease (S34 v2 §10.2).

self_video.description: The member holds a camera lease (S34 v2 §10.2).

server_deaf.description: Deafened by a moderator (persistent per space).

server_mute.description: Muted by a moderator (persistent per space).

space_id.description: The channel's space; absent for DM calls.

speak_denied.description: The member lacks SPEAK here; clients show it as muted.

Vp9Hint.description: VP9 publishing rules when VP9 is configured (S34 v2 §13).

requires_dd.description: Always `true`: the Dependency Descriptor is required.

description: The `ready` dispatch: a small boot snapshot (C7).

call_keys.description: Call key trust anchors and client parameters (S50 §9.4); absent when voice is disabled.

calls.description:
Active calls in the member's DMs, at most 100; the member's own copy of each carries
`my_ring` (S34 v2 §20.2).

channels.description: Channels the member belongs to, plus DMs.

dm_members.description: Partners of the most recent DMs, at most 50 (S18).

member_seq.description: Head of the member's change log.

notify.description: Notification settings and explicit prefs (S21 gap G17).

recordings.description:
Active recordings in rooms whose voice state the member may see, at most 100, each
with the member's own `my_consent` (S35 v2 §18.3).

resume_url.description: Advisory resume URL (clients resume at their ticket's URL, contracts rev 22).

session_id.description: The gateway session id, for RESUME.

voice_channels.description: Public voice channels the member can view but has not joined (S33 v1 §16.3).

voice_states.description: Voice states in voice channels the member can view, at most 5,000 (S33 v1 §16.3).
